whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.intro: Connect the WhatsApp Business app number your team already uses. Scan a QR code in the app; the number then appears here.
whatsapp.timeout: WhatsApp took too long to answer. Try again.
whatsapp.loadError: The WhatsApp connection window could not load. Reload the page and try again.
whatsapp.awaiting: WhatsApp connections are waiting for Meta approval.
whatsapp.limitNotice: Until Meta finishes verifying SharkX, WhatsApp allows only a few new connections per week (about 10). If a connection is refused for this reason, you will see it here.

table.caption: WhatsApp numbers
table.label: Label
table.emptyBody: Connect the number your team uses in the WhatsApp Business app.

signupErrors.appVersion: Update the WhatsApp Business app to the latest version, then try again.
signupErrors.notEligible: This number cannot be connected yet. Keep using it in the WhatsApp Business app for a few more days, then try again.
signupErrors.personal: This number is on personal WhatsApp. Move it to the WhatsApp Business app first.
signupErrors.notBusinessApp: This number is not on the WhatsApp Business app, so it cannot be connected with a QR code.
signupErrors.country: WhatsApp does not allow this connection for numbers from this country yet.
signupErrors.limit: SharkX has reached Meta's limit for new WhatsApp connections this week. Try again in a few days.
signupErrors.qrRate: Too many QR codes were requested. Wait a few minutes and try again.
signupErrors.qrFailed: The QR code did not work. Get a new code and scan it again.
signupErrors.disconnecting: This number is still being disconnected from its previous connection. Try again later.
signupErrors.otherProvider: This number is connected through another provider. Disconnect it there first.
signupErrors.notEnabled: WhatsApp connections are not enabled yet for SharkX. Contact SharkX.
signupErrors.unknownNoMessage: WhatsApp could not finish the connection (code {code}). Try again.

reasons.not_configured: WhatsApp connections are not set up on this environment yet. Contact SharkX.
reasons.qr_only: Only a number that is already on the WhatsApp Business app can be connected. Choose your WhatsApp Business app number and scan the QR code.
reasons.code_expired: The connection took too long and expired. Try again.
reasons.waba_mismatch: Meta did not confirm access to that WhatsApp account. Try again and pick the account you want to connect.
reasons.no_number: We could not find that number on the WhatsApp Business app. Check that it is active in the app, then try again.
reasons.subscribe_failed: Meta did not accept the connection. Try again in a few minutes.
reasons.graph_unavailable: WhatsApp (Meta) is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.
reasons.number_taken: This number is already connected to another client in SharkX. Disconnect it there first.
reasons.generic: WhatsApp could not finish the connection. Try again in a few minutes.
